verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online documents its own bank reconciliation. It imports bank and card transactions, auto-matches invoice payments, generates a reconciliation report, and offers discrepancy and missing-check reports to surface mismatches. Explicit review queues for matched versus unmatched transactions are only implied, and duplicate detection is not evidenced at all. missing for 10: duplicate-transaction detection, an explicit matched/unmatched review workflow per account, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: Reconcile bank statements in minutes with QuickBooks.
Connect QuickBooks to your bank, credit cards, PayPal, Square, and more1 and we’ll import your transactions for you.
When you finish reconciling accounts, QuickBooks automatically generates a reconciliation report.
There are several reports – such as the The Reconciliation Discrepancy Report, the Missing Checks Report, and the Transaction Detail Report – that can help you identify discrepancies quickly.
When customers pay through QuickBooks invoices, we’ll record and match it for you.
